channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: The $875 proxy bill was a 1.5 MB manifest
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: One day, written up: a proxy bill that looked like a credential leak and was really a playlist file polled every few seconds, SiriusXM landing on tipoffwatch, Spotify Connect on bittorrented.com, and a librespot bug where songs skipped after a few seconds.

item.title: A one-field funnel for launch.anapp.now
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: How the launch.anapp.now campaign site is built: one textarea instead of a signup form, a server-side handoff into Chovy that keeps the idea out of URLs, four hero headlines under test, and first-party tracking with no pixels.

item.title: One terminal window, 26 social networks
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: myna is a social media manager that runs in your terminal. It counts characters the way each network counts them, is honest about which of the 26 need a password and which need a browser, and keeps your credentials encrypted on your own machine.

item.title: Work is not disappearing. The job is.
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The salaried, 9-to-5, one-employer-for-decades package is an industrial-age artifact, and it is coming apart. What the return-to-office data, the independent workforce numbers and Harvard's research on degree requirements actually show.

item.title: The Moshpit resolves
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: alt.2600 is not a domain and never will be, but it answers a stock curl over HTTPS. The Moshpit namespace is in beta: claim an ending for $5, mint names under it for nothing, no renewals.

item.title: Why I wrote hqtui
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Every TypeScript terminal UI library is either abandoned since 2015, a React flexbox layout engine, or a native binary behind FFI. I wanted btop quality with zero dependencies, so I wrote hqtui.

item.title: Why I built DiskPush
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: FileZilla re-uploads a folder because one file changed; rsync does not, but it means remembering the flags. I wanted the two pane browser on top of the rsync engine, could not find it, so we built it.

item.title: I cloned myself at chovy.com
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: chovy.com went from a 240-character microblog to an AI clone of me: a four-line advisor persona, an isolated coding worker on its own service, and a roster where human teammates and AI workers are counted separately.

item.title: Four days at Lake Almanor
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Four days off the computer at Lake Almanor with two friends from high school. The backpack with all the warez stayed home, so the dispensary in Westwood and the smoke shop in Chester restocked the trip in one afternoon.

item.title: Cards and crypto in one checkout
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: One API call returns a Polygon address and a live Stripe Checkout session. Putting both rails behind one page, the bug that meant the card tab never rendered, and what ten days of realtime fraud screening actually logged.
